exercises.name: Ring Pull Up

source_english.description: Ring Pull Up pulls from a controlled hang until the chin reaches or clears the bar, then lowers under control.
instructions: Hang from the rings with arms straight, shoulders active, and legs controlled.
Brace the core and pull the elbows down as the chest rises toward the rings.
Reach the chin above ring height or to a controlled top position.
Lower to a full hang without letting the rings swing.
form_cues: Keep the rings close to the body.
source_english.safety_note: Check the rings and straps are secure and use assistance if the shoulders cannot control the instability.

exercises.name: Squat (Band)

source_english.description: Squat (Band) lowers the hips by bending the hips and knees and returns to standing by driving through the feet.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band placed just above your knees.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat position.
Make sure your knees are tracking over your toes and your weight is in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
form_cues: Keep the knees tracking the toes.
Brace the trunk through the depth.
common_mistakes: Bouncing or cutting the depth short.
source_english.safety_note: Use a rack or machine stops and choose a depth you can control with both feet planted.

selected_render_scene.pose: Feet shoulder-width/heels grounded, hips back and knees aligned with toes, chest lifted, paused comfortable depth.
selected_render_scene.grip: Hands free for balance, no held bar or long-band ends.
selected_render_scene.supports_and_equipment: Short band LOOP just ABOVE knees, both feet on floor, passive unweighted RACK safety option nearby as English permits. No machine stops/rails, cable, weight stack or band under feet.
selected_render_scene.movement_trajectory: Flex hips/knees with controlled band tension above knees, then drive through heels to stand.
selected_render_scene.camera: Front-side three-quarter view showing whole person, all supports/anchors and each prescribed contact; square frame, no crop.

technique_resolution.rationale_uk: Selected 1004 і всі instructions задають петлю ВИЩЕ колін, не довгу band deadlift петлю під стопами. English safety дозволяє rack OR machine stops: обрано лише пасивну стійку поруч/навколо вправи як safety option, без направляючих, тросів, вагового стека чи зміни опор ніг. Каталожна safety вимога збережена, не оголошена помилкою здогадкою.
